edits.content:
## Notes

- Segments are sorted by start time
- Compatible with video-processor --remove-segments input
- All input files must have `segments` array
- Segments within merge-gap seconds of each other are merged into one; the output contains no overlaps and no gaps smaller than merge-gap.
- Merging improves IoU-based precision when ground-truth pauses are contiguous spans but detectors produce fragmented adjacent detections (e.g., {522-524} + {525-527} → {522-527}).
